clusters.title: Bank Statement Converters
clusters.blurb: Turn PDF bank and card statements into dated, signed transaction rows with running balances.

clusters.title: SaaS & Cloud Invoice Converters
clusters.blurb: Extract line items, usage charges, tax and totals from software, cloud and advertising invoices.

clusters.title: E-Commerce, Marketplace & Payment Receipts
clusters.blurb: Convert order receipts, marketplace statements and payout reports into spreadsheet rows.

clusters.title: Accounting Workflows
clusters.blurb: Task-focused converters for bookkeeping imports, batch extraction and offline table capture.

pages.name: Chase Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Chase statements usually group deposits, withdrawals and fees into separate sections; each section is read with the same date-and-amount rules, so check the sign of fee rows after conversion.

pages.name: Bank of America Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Bank of America statements commonly print short MM/DD dates without a year; the year is taken from the statement period at the top of the document.

pages.name: Wells Fargo Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Wells Fargo layouts typically show separate deposit and withdrawal columns plus an ending daily balance, which map to the Credit, Debit and Balance columns.

pages.name: HSBC PDF Statement to Excel
pages.hint: HSBC statements often wrap long payment details onto a second line; wrapped lines are merged back into the transaction description.

pages.name: Barclays Statement PDF to QuickBooks CSV
pages.hint: Barclays statements normally use 'Money out' and 'Money in' columns; they are combined into the single signed Amount column that QuickBooks Online expects in its bank upload.

pages.name: Revolut PDF Statement to CSV
pages.hint: Revolut statements can contain several currency accounts in one PDF; convert it once, then filter or delete rows per currency in the grid before exporting.

pages.name: Wise Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Wise statements list conversions and fees as separate lines; each becomes its own row so fees stay visible to your bookkeeping.

pages.name: Standard Chartered Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Standard Chartered statements frequently mark amounts with CR and DR suffixes; both are recognised and converted to positive and negative numbers.

pages.name: Citi Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Citi statements may show both a transaction date and a posting date; the first date is kept and the second is dropped so each row has one clean date.

pages.name: Capital One Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: On Capital One card statements, payments and credits are usually shown with a minus sign; signs are preserved exactly as printed.

pages.name: American Express Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: American Express statements often show foreign-currency detail under a charge; that extra line is appended to the description instead of becoming a broken row.

pages.name: TD Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: TD statements typically list activity by category with subtotal lines; subtotal and total lines are skipped so they are not double-counted.

pages.name: Lloyds Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Lloyds statements generally use day-month-year dates and Paid in / Paid out columns, which are detected from the table header.

pages.name: NatWest Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: NatWest statements commonly print 'Brought forward' and 'Carried forward' balances; these are captured as opening and closing balances rather than transactions.

pages.name: Santander Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Santander statements from different countries use different number formats; both 1,234.56 and 1.234,56 styles are parsed.

pages.name: Monzo Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Monzo statements usually have a single signed amount column and a running balance, which gives a direct opening-to-closing reconciliation check.

pages.name: N26 Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: N26 statements are issued in euros with comma decimals; amounts such as 1.234,56 are normalised to plain numbers for spreadsheets.

pages.name: Commonwealth Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: CommBank statements often print balances with CR or DR after the figure; the suffix sets the sign of the Balance column.

pages.name: RBC Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: RBC statements commonly print a date only on the first transaction of each day; later rows without a date inherit the date printed above them.

pages.name: HBL Bank Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: HBL statements are denominated in PKR and often use Rs. prefixes and large comma-grouped amounts, all of which are parsed to plain numbers.

pages.name: Meezan Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Meezan Bank statements typically list Debit, Credit and Balance columns in PKR with DD-Mon-YYYY dates, which convert to ISO dates automatically.

pages.name: U.S. Bank Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: U.S. Bank statements usually separate deposits, card withdrawals and checks into different tables; every table is read in one pass.

pages.name: AWS Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: AWS invoices summarise charges per service with separate tax lines; each service charge becomes a row and tax is captured in the summary fields.

pages.name: Stripe Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Stripe-generated invoices follow a consistent Description / Qty / Unit price / Amount table, which maps directly onto the four output columns.

pages.name: Google Cloud Billing PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Google Cloud invoices often show credits as negative amounts next to usage; negative and bracketed figures are kept negative so the net matches the invoice total.

pages.name: DigitalOcean Invoice PDF to JSON
pages.hint: DigitalOcean invoices list each Droplet and resource with hours and a rate; the JSON output keeps qty, unit_price and amount as numbers for scripts.

pages.name: Vercel Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Vercel invoices mix a flat plan fee with metered usage lines; both kinds of line are extracted into the same table.

pages.name: GitHub Receipt PDF to Excel
pages.hint: GitHub receipts are short, with seat-based lines for plans and add-ons; the receipt preset also records the payment date as the issue date.

pages.name: Shopify Bill PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Shopify bills combine subscription, app and transaction-fee charges; each charge is exported as a separate row for cost analysis.

pages.name: Meta Ads Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Meta ads invoices list spend per campaign; campaign names stay intact in the Description column, including long names that wrap onto a second line.

pages.name: Google Ads Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Google Ads invoices show campaign-level costs with quantities such as clicks or impressions; quantity and amount are kept in separate columns.

pages.name: Microsoft Azure Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Azure invoices can run to many pages; the table header is re-detected on every page so column mapping stays aligned.

pages.name: Cloudflare Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Cloudflare invoices list plans and add-ons per zone; zone names remain part of each description for per-domain cost tracking.

pages.name: OpenAI Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: OpenAI invoices for API usage are typically short, with credit purchases or usage lines plus tax; totals are checked against the sum of the lines.

pages.name: Slack Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Slack invoices usually bill per active member with prorated adjustments; prorated credit lines are kept as negative amounts.

pages.name: Zoom Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Zoom invoices list each licence type with a quantity and service period; the period text is kept in the description.

pages.name: HubSpot Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: HubSpot invoices often include discounts as separate lines under each product; discount rows are skipped from line items and the net shows in the totals.

pages.name: Atlassian Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Atlassian invoices itemise Jira, Confluence and marketplace apps by user tier; each product line becomes one row.

pages.name: Notion Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Notion invoices are compact seat-based documents; the invoice number, dates and total are captured in the summary panel for quick filing.

pages.name: LinkedIn Ads Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: LinkedIn advertising invoices list spend per campaign group with tax shown separately; tax lands in the Tax / VAT summary field.

pages.name: PayPal Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: PayPal statements show gross, fee and net figures per payment; when three amounts appear on a row, check which one landed in Amount and adjust in the grid if you need net instead of gross.

pages.name: Amazon Order Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Amazon order invoices list items with quantity and price, then shipping and tax; items become rows while shipping and tax stay in the totals.

pages.name: eBay Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: eBay seller invoices list fee types such as final value and promoted listing fees; each fee line is extracted so you can total fees by type.

pages.name: Etsy Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Etsy payment account statements interleave sales, fees and deposits by date; the bank preset keeps them in order with signed amounts.

pages.name: Uber Receipt PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Uber receipts break a fare into trip fare, fees and tolls; each component is a row, which helps with expense reports that need the split.

pages.name: Airbnb Receipt PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Airbnb receipts show nightly rate times nights, cleaning fee, service fee and taxes; nightly charges keep their quantity and rate.

pages.name: Walmart Receipt PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Walmart online order receipts list each item with quantity and price; digital PDF receipts work, while photographed paper receipts need OCR first.

pages.name: Apple Receipt PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Apple receipts for apps and subscriptions are short single-table documents; save the email as PDF, then drop it here.

pages.name: Upwork Invoice PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Upwork invoices usually cover a single contract and period with hours and rate; hours map to Qty and the hourly rate to Unit Price.

pages.name: Fiverr Invoice PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Fiverr invoices list the order amount and a separate service fee; both are exported so the fee can be booked to its own account.

pages.name: Square Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Square statements summarise daily sales, fees and transfers; fee rows printed in brackets are converted to negative numbers.

pages.name: Payoneer Statement PDF to Excel
pages.hint: Payoneer statements are issued per currency balance; convert each currency statement separately or batch them into one workbook with a sheet per file.

pages.name: PDF Invoice to QuickBooks CSV
pages.hint: The QuickBooks Online preset writes the three-column Date, Description, Amount layout; invoice lines are written as money out, dated at the invoice date.

pages.name: PDF Statement to Xero CSV
pages.hint: The Xero preset follows Xero's statement import template with *Date and *Amount columns plus Payee, Description and Reference.

pages.name: Receipt PDF to JSON
pages.hint: This works on PDFs that contain real text, such as emailed or downloaded receipts. A scanned or photographed receipt has no text layer; run it through OCR software first, then convert the result here.

pages.name: Extract Tables from PDF Locally
pages.hint: Tables are rebuilt from the x and y coordinates of every text fragment, so columns stay aligned even when the PDF stores text out of reading order.

pages.name: Batch PDF Invoice Extractor
pages.hint: Drop several invoices at once: each becomes its own worksheet, and a Summary sheet lists invoice number, vendor, dates and totals for every file. The free tier handles three files per batch.

pages.name: PDF Bank Statement to CSV
pages.hint: Any bank's digital statement works as long as rows contain a date and an amount; the opening and closing balances are used to confirm nothing was missed.

pages.name: PDF Invoice to Excel
pages.hint: The workbook stores quantities and amounts as real numbers, not text, so SUM and pivot tables work without clean-up.

pages.name: PDF to JSON Invoice Parser
pages.hint: The JSON output has a summary object and a rows array with stable keys, which makes it straightforward to feed into scripts or internal tools.

pages.name: Credit Card Statement PDF to CSV
pages.hint: Card statements print purchases as positive figures and payments as credits; review the sign convention in the grid and flip it if your ledger treats spending as negative.

pages.name: PDF Receipt to CSV
pages.hint: Receipts rarely have a formal table header, so items are detected as text followed by a price, with subtotal, tax and total lines captured separately.

pages.name: Offline PDF to CSV Converter
pages.hint: Once the page and its PDF engine have finished loading, parsing uses no network at all: you can disconnect from the internet, drop a PDF and still export CSV or JSON.

pages.name: PDF Statement to Google Sheets
pages.hint: Export CSV and use File > Import in Google Sheets, or copy the CSV from the code inspector and paste it into cell A1 with 'Split text to columns'.

pages.name: Invoice Data Extraction Without Upload
pages.hint: Open your browser's Network tab while converting: no request carries your document, because parsing happens in this tab's own memory.

pages.name: PDF Utility Bill to Excel
pages.hint: Utility bills list charges such as supply, usage and levies with amounts; each charge becomes a row and the amount due is captured as the total.
